text:
An athlete hears a starting pistol fire 1.5 seconds after she sees a puff of smoke from the pistol.
The sound and the smoke are made at the same time. The starting pistol is 450 metres away
from the athlete.
What is the speed of sound calculated from this observation?
A
150m/s
B
300m/s
C
330m/s
D
675m/s
subject: Physics
